_comment: Mutant ids that existed at some point and were withdrawn. An id is never reused: a retired id must not appear in any spec.

retired.reason: withdrawn with the redundant id-type check in store.load (the file-name check already pins the type)
withdrawn with the redundant startswith('/') check in sources._valid_path (an empty first segment is refused anyway); the NUL-in-path mutant that briefly reused this id is now K54
withdrawn with the redundant guard before validate_namespaces in aliases.main
withdrawn with the redundant 'only a label can be migrated' check in ledger.validate_ledger (the class/disposition tie covers it)

withdrawn with the clause `not superseded_by_fail` in evidence._platform_state: an ACTIVE failure now always blocks, only its own lifecycle lifts it (conservative; the clause could only matter when the superseding failure was itself not active)
withdrawn with the redundant verify_files call in localcat check (a catalog equal to the build was just built from verified files)
